items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
نستخدم صيغة الأمر (imperative) لإعطاء تعليمات واضحة ومباشرة في قوائم الفحص وأدلة الصيانة. نبدأ الجملة بالفعل في صورته الأساسية بدون فاعل: Check, Clean, Tighten. للنفي نضع Do not أو Don't قبل الفعل. وللتأكيد على قواعد السلامة نستخدم Always وNever في بداية الجملة. وفي التعليمات المتسلسلة نضيف كلمات الترتيب first, then, next, finally. اجعل كل تعليمة قصيرة، بفعل واحد واضح ومفعول به محدد، لأن ذلك يقلل الأخطاء في الورشة.

الشكل (Form):
- الإثبات: base verb + object → Check the oil level.
- النفي: Do not / Don't + base verb → Do not open the panel.
- التأكيد: Always / Never + base verb → Always wear gloves. / Never touch moving parts.
- التهذيب: Please + base verb → Please sign the checklist.
- التسلسل: First, ... Then, ... Next, ... Finally, ...

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) First, switch off the conveyor. Then, inspect the belt for cracks. — «أولًا، أوقف الناقل. ثم افحص السير بحثًا عن تشققات.»
2) Never lubricate the chain while the motor is running. — «لا تُزيّت السلسلة أبدًا والمحرك يعمل.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
يضيف بعض المتعلمين فاعلًا أو to قبل الفعل: «You check the oil» أو «To check the oil» بدل «Check the oil». ويقولون «No touch» بدل «Do not touch». في التعليمات يبدأ الأمر بالفعل الأساسي مباشرة، ويكون النفي بـ Do not أو Never.

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Choose the correct instruction for a checklist.
A) Checking the oil level.
B) You checks the oil level.
C) Check the oil level.
Answer: C

2) Choose the correct negative instruction.
A) No open the panel.
B) Do not open the panel.
C) Not open the panel.
Answer: B

3) Complete: ___ safety gloves before you touch the blade.
A) Wears
B) Wear
C) Wearing
Answer: B

4) Complete: ___ touch moving parts.
A) Not
B) Never
C) No
Answer: B

5) Choose the best first step in a maintenance task.
A) First, switching off the main power.
B) First, switch off the main power.
C) First, you switched off the main power.
Answer: B

6) Complete: ___ the chain once a week.
A) Lubricates
B) To lubricating
C) Lubricate
Answer: C

7) Which sentence is a clear instruction?
A) Tighten the four bolts.
B) The four bolts tightening.
C) Tightened the four bolts.
Answer: A

8) Complete: Please ___ the checklist when you finish.
A) sign
B) signs
C) signed
Answer: A

9) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Don't remove the guard.
B) Don't removes the guard.
C) Don't removing the guard.
Answer: A

10) Complete: ___ wear safety glasses in the workshop.
A) Ever
B) Always
C) Every
Answer: B

11) Which sentence gives a safety warning correctly?
A) Never stand under a lifted load.
B) Never to stand under a lifted load.
C) Never standing under a lifted load.
Answer: A

12) Complete the sequence: First, isolate the power. ___, inspect the cables.
A) Then
B) Than
C) Them
Answer: A

13) Choose the correct instruction for cleaning a sensor.
A) Cleaning the lens with a dry cloth.
B) Cleans the lens with a dry cloth.
C) Clean the lens with a dry cloth.
Answer: C

14) Complete: ___ use water on electrical equipment.
A) Does not
B) Do not
C) Not to
Answer: B

15) Which instruction is the most precise?
A) Tighten the bolt a lot.
B) Tighten the bolt to 25 N·m.
C) Tighten the bolt maybe.
Answer: B

16) Choose the correct word order.
A) Check the belt tension every week.
B) Every week the belt tension check.
C) Check every week the belt tension.
Answer: A

17) Complete: ___ the machine before you clean it.
A) Stop
B) Stops
C) Stopped
Answer: A

18) Choose the correct polite negative.
A) Please not lean on the robot cell.
B) Please no lean on the robot cell.
C) Please do not lean on the robot cell.
Answer: C

19) A colleague asks how to restart the line. Choose the best answer.
A) You resetting the alarm, then press the green start button.
B) Reset the alarm, then pressing the green start button.
C) Reset the alarm, then press the green start button.
Answer: C

20) Choose the correct final step.
A) Finally, recorded the results in the log.
B) Finally, to record the results in the log.
C) Finally, record the results in the log.
Answer: C

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب 5 تعليمات قصيرة بصيغة الأمر لفحص ناقل (conveyor) قبل بدء الوردية، واستخدم first وthen وfinally، ومرة واحدة على الأقل Never أو Do not.
2) اكتب تعليمتين للسلامة عند تزييت محمل (bearing): واحدة تبدأ بـ Always وأخرى تبدأ بـ Never.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/commands-and-instructions
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/imperative-clauses-be-quiet

items.titleArabic: الإلزام والمنع في قواعد السلامة: must وhave to وmustn't وdon't have to
items.titleEnglish: Safety rules: must, have to, mustn't and don't have to
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
في قواعد السلامة نحتاج إلى التمييز بين أربعة معانٍ. must وhave to تعبّران عن الإلزام: You must wear safety glasses. نستخدم have to غالبًا عندما يأتي الإلزام من قاعدة أو جهة خارجية، ونستخدم must عندما يرى المتكلم أن الأمر ضروري، والمعنى في الورشة متقارب جدًا. أما mustn't فتعني الحظر: هذا ممنوع. وdon't have to تعني عدم الضرورة: لست مضطرًا، لكن يمكنك إن أردت. هذا الفرق مهم جدًا: You mustn't open the panel (ممنوع) تختلف عن You don't have to open the panel (غير ضروري). وفي الماضي نستخدم had to لأن must ليس لها صيغة ماضٍ. هذا الدرس يكمل ما تعلمته في الأسبوع الثالث عن الأفعال الناقصة في تعليمات السلامة.

الشكل (Form):
- must + base verb → You must wear PPE.
- have to / has to + base verb → She has to sign the permit.
- mustn't + base verb (ممنوع) → You mustn't remove the guard.
- don't / doesn't have to + base verb (غير ضروري) → You don't have to wear a helmet in the office.
- الماضي: had to + base verb → We had to stop the line.
- السؤال: Do I have to ...? (الأكثر شيوعًا) / Must I ...?

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) Visitors have to wear safety shoes, but they don't have to wear gloves in the office area. — «يجب على الزوار ارتداء أحذية السلامة، لكنهم غير مضطرين لارتداء القفازات في منطقة المكاتب.»
2) You mustn't start the robot when someone is inside the cell. — «يُمنع تشغيل الروبوت عندما يكون أحد داخل الخلية.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
الخطأ الشائع هو استخدام don't have to بمعنى «ممنوع». الجملة You don't have to touch the wire تعني «لست مضطرًا للمسه» وليست تحذيرًا. للتحذير قل You mustn't touch the wire. ومن الأخطاء أيضًا إضافة to بعد must: «You must to wear» والصحيح «You must wear».

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Complete: You ___ wear safety glasses in the workshop. It is a rule.
A) mustn't
B) must
C) don't have to
Answer: B

2) Complete: You ___ touch live wires. It is not allowed.
A) don't have to
B) mustn't
C) have to
Answer: B

3) Complete: Visitors ___ wear PPE on the shop floor.
A) has to
B) having to
C) have to
Answer: C

4) Choose the correct sentence.
A) You must wear a helmet.
B) You must to wear a helmet.
C) You must wearing a helmet.
Answer: A

5) Complete: Office staff ___ wear safety shoes in the office. It is not necessary.
A) don't have to
B) mustn't
C) must
Answer: A

6) Complete: The technician ___ get a permit before hot work.
A) has to
B) have to
C) must to
Answer: A

7) What does "You mustn't remove the guard" mean?
A) Removing the guard is not necessary.
B) Removing the guard is a good idea.
C) Removing the guard is not allowed.
Answer: C

8) What does "You don't have to stop the line for this check" mean?
A) You can do the check without stopping the line.
B) Stopping the line is forbidden.
C) You must stop the line.
Answer: A

9) Complete: Yesterday we ___ stop the line because of a leak.
A) must
B) had to
C) have to
Answer: B

10) Choose the correct question.
A) Do I have to sign the checklist?
B) Do I must sign the checklist?
C) Does I have to sign the checklist?
Answer: A

11) Complete: Operators ___ smoke near the fuel tank.
A) don't have to
B) doesn't have to
C) mustn't
Answer: C

12) Complete: She ___ check the pressure every hour. It is in the procedure.
A) have to
B) has to
C) having to
Answer: B

13) Complete: You ___ bring your own tools. We give you a full toolbox.
A) mustn't
B) must
C) don't have to
Answer: C

14) Choose the correct negative of "He has to wear gloves."
A) He hasn't to wear gloves.
B) He don't have to wear gloves.
C) He doesn't have to wear gloves.
Answer: C

15) Complete: Before maintenance, you ___ isolate the power supply.
A) mustn't
B) must
C) don't have to
Answer: B

16) Which sentence is a prohibition?
A) You mustn't enter the robot cell during operation.
B) You don't have to enter the robot cell during operation.
C) You have to enter the robot cell during operation.
Answer: A

17) Complete: Last week the team ___ replace two damaged guards.
A) must
B) has to
C) had to
Answer: C

18) Complete: Only authorized staff can open the panel. You ___ open it without permission.
A) don't have to
B) mustn't
C) have to
Answer: B

19) Hearing protection is optional in the office. Choose the correct rule.
A) You don't have to wear hearing protection in the office.
B) You mustn't wear hearing protection in the office.
C) You must wear hearing protection in the office.
Answer: A

20) Choose the best safety rule for a robot cell.
A) Everyone have to press the stop button before entering the cell.
B) Everyone has to press the stop button before entering the cell.
C) Everyone has to pressing the stop button before entering the cell.
Answer: B

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب 4 قواعد سلامة لورشة ميكاترونيك: قاعدتان بـ must أو have to، وقاعدة بـ mustn't، وقاعدة بـ don't have to.
2) اكتب جملتين عن شيء اضطررت لفعله في مختبر أو تدريب سابق باستخدام had to.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/must
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/have-got-to-and-have-to

items.titleArabic: ظروف التكرار وعبارات الجدولة في الصيانة الوقائية
items.titleEnglish: Frequency adverbs and expressions for maintenance schedules
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
لوصف جداول الصيانة نستخدم ظروف التكرار مثل always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never، وعبارات التكرار مثل every day, once a week, twice a month, every 500 hours. يأتي ظرف التكرار عادة قبل الفعل الأساسي: We usually check the filters on Monday، ويأتي بعد فعل be: The pump is always noisy at start-up. أما عبارات التكرار الطويلة فتأتي عادة في نهاية الجملة: Change the oil every 500 operating hours. ونستخدم المضارع البسيط مع هذه الكلمات لأنها تصف عادة أو جدولًا ثابتًا. وللسؤال عن التكرار نستخدم How often ...?

الشكل (Form):
- subject + adverb + main verb → We often clean the sensors.
- be + adverb → The filter is usually dirty after a month.
- التعبير في نهاية الجملة → Inspect the belts once a week. / every 250 hours / twice a year
- السؤال → How often do you replace the seals? — Every six months.
- once = مرة، twice = مرتين، three times = ثلاث مرات

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) We usually lubricate the bearings once a week, but we check the belts every day. — «عادةً نزيّت المحامل مرة في الأسبوع، لكننا نفحص السيور كل يوم.»
2) The air filter is often blocked after 200 operating hours. — «غالبًا ما يكون فلتر الهواء مسدودًا بعد 200 ساعة تشغيل.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
يضع كثير من المتعلمين ظرف التكرار بعد الفعل: «We check always the oil» والصحيح «We always check the oil». ويقولون «one time in the week» بدل «once a week»، و«two times» بدل «twice» في الكتابة المهنية.

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Choose the correct sentence.
A) We check always the oil level.
B) We always check the oil level.
C) Always we checks the oil level.
Answer: B

2) Complete: The technician ___ inspects the gearbox on Fridays.
A) usual
B) usually
C) use
Answer: B

3) Choose the correct expression.
A) one time in week
B) once in the week time
C) once a week
Answer: C

4) Complete: Change the filter ___ six months.
A) each of
B) all
C) every
Answer: C

5) Choose the correct question.
A) How often do you clean the sensors?
B) How often you clean the sensors?
C) How much often do you clean the sensors?
Answer: A

6) Choose the correct sentence with "be".
A) The motor rarely is hot.
B) The motor is rarely hot.
C) Rarely the motor is hot.
Answer: B

7) Complete: We test the emergency stop ___ a month.
A) twice
B) two
C) second
Answer: A

8) Which word means "almost never"?
A) often
B) usually
C) rarely
Answer: C

9) Complete: The robot ___ stops without a reason. It is very reliable.
A) rarely
B) often
C) always
Answer: A

10) Choose the correct sentence.
A) We replace sometimes the seals early.
B) We sometimes replaces the seals early.
C) We sometimes replace the seals early.
Answer: C

11) Complete: Lubricate the chain every 100 ___.
A) operating hour
B) operating hours
C) operate hours
Answer: B

12) Answer the question "How often do you calibrate the scale?"
A) Since three months.
B) Every three months.
C) For three months.
Answer: B

13) Complete: The safety team ___ checks the fire extinguishers on the first day of the month.
A) ever
B) always
C) yet
Answer: B

14) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Our team never miss the weekly check.
B) Our team misses never the weekly check.
C) Our team never misses the weekly check.
Answer: C

15) Complete: The compressor is ___ noisy in the morning.
A) oftenly
B) often
C) many time
Answer: B

16) Which word shows the highest frequency?
A) always
B) usually
C) sometimes
Answer: A

17) Complete: We do a full overhaul ___ a year.
A) once
B) one
C) first
Answer: A

18) Choose the correct sentence for a schedule.
A) The service team visits the site every two weeks.
B) The service team visit every two weeks the site.
C) The service team visits the site each two weeks.
Answer: A

19) Complete: Operators ___ wear gloves near the press. It is a rule with no exceptions.
A) rarely
B) sometimes
C) always
Answer: C

20) Choose the best sentence for a maintenance plan.
A) We usually replace the air filter every 500 operating hours.
B) We replace usually the air filter all 500 operating hours.
C) Usually we replacing the air filter every 500 operating hours.
Answer: A

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب جدول صيانة قصيرًا (4 جمل) لروبوت أو ناقل باستخدام: every day, once a week, twice a month, every 500 operating hours.
2) اكتب جملتين عن عاداتك في المختبر أو الورشة باستخدام always وrarely أو never.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/adverbs-and-adverb-phrases-position
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/adverbs-types

items.titleArabic: المبني للمجهول في المضارع البسيط لوصف إجراءات الصيانة
items.titleEnglish: Present simple passive for maintenance procedures
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
في وصف الإجراءات التقنية يكون المهم هو العملية نفسها وليس الشخص الذي يقوم بها، لذلك نستخدم المبني للمجهول (passive). يتكون في المضارع البسيط من am/is/are + التصريف الثالث للفعل (past participle): The filter is replaced every month. إذا أردنا ذكر من يقوم بالعمل نضيف by: The robot is programmed by the automation team، وإذا ذكرنا الأداة نستخدم with: The bolts are tightened with a torque wrench. يكثر هذا الأسلوب في الأدلة الفنية والتقارير لأنه يبدو موضوعيًا ومهنيًا. للنفي نضيف not بعد is/are، وللسؤال نقدّم is/are على الفاعل.

الشكل (Form):
- is/are + past participle → The belts are checked daily.
- is/are + not + past participle → The motor is not opened during the warranty period.
- Is/Are + subject + past participle? → Is the oil changed every 500 hours?
- + by + الفاعل → The PLC is updated by the vendor.
- + with + الأداة → The bolts are tightened with a torque wrench.
- تصريفات شائعة: check→checked, replace→replaced, make→made, send→sent, keep→kept, take→taken

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) First, the main power is switched off. Then the guard is removed and the belt is inspected. — «أولًا، يُفصل التيار الرئيسي. ثم يُزال الواقي ويُفحص السير.»
2) The bolts are tightened to 40 N·m with a torque wrench. — «تُشدّ البراغي حتى 40 نيوتن·متر بمفتاح عزم.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
ينسى المتعلمون فعل be فيكتبون «The filter replaced every month»، فتُفهم الجملة كأنها ماضٍ ناقص. والصحيح «The filter is replaced every month». كما يستخدمون الفعل الأساسي بعد is: «The oil is change» والصحيح «The oil is changed».

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Choose the correct passive sentence.
A) The filter replaced every month.
B) The filter is replaced every month.
C) The filter is replace every month.
Answer: B

2) Complete: The belts ___ checked every day.
A) is
B) are
C) be
Answer: B

3) Complete: The oil is ___ every 500 hours.
A) changed
B) change
C) changing
Answer: A

4) Choose the passive form of "We test the sensors every week."
A) The sensors are tested every week.
B) The sensors tested every week.
C) The sensors are test every week.
Answer: A

5) Complete: The bolts are tightened ___ a torque wrench.
A) with
B) by
C) from
Answer: A

6) Complete: The software ___ updated by the vendor once a year.
A) are
B) be
C) is
Answer: C

7) Choose the correct negative.
A) The motor not is opened during the warranty period.
B) The motor is not opened during the warranty period.
C) The motor does not opened during the warranty period.
Answer: B

8) Choose the correct question.
A) Does the pressure checked every shift?
B) Is the pressure check every shift?
C) Is the pressure checked every shift?
Answer: C

9) Complete: Spare parts ___ kept in the store room.
A) is
B) are
C) be
Answer: B

10) What is the past participle of "send"?
A) sended
B) sent
C) sending
Answer: B

11) Complete: The machine ___ by two operators.
A) operates by
B) is operate
C) is operated
Answer: C

12) Choose the best sentence for a maintenance manual.
A) The chain is lubricated once a week.
B) Somebody lubricates maybe the chain once a week.
C) The chain lubricate once a week.
Answer: A

13) Complete: The test results ___ recorded in the log.
A) is
B) are
C) does
Answer: B

14) Choose the passive form of "The team tests every robot."
A) Every robot are tested by the team.
B) Every robot is tested by the team.
C) Every robot tested by the team.
Answer: B

15) Complete: The guard is ___ before the belt is inspected.
A) removed
B) remove
C) removing
Answer: A

16) Which sentence is active, not passive?
A) The seal is replaced.
B) The seal is replaced by the technician.
C) The technician replaces the seal.
Answer: C

17) Complete: Where ___ the spare fuses kept?
A) are
B) is
C) do
Answer: A

18) Complete: These motors ___ made in Germany.
A) is
B) be
C) are
Answer: C

19) Choose the correct sequence.
A) The power isolated, and then the cover opened is.
B) The power is isolate, and then the cover is open.
C) The power is isolated, and then the cover is opened.
Answer: C

20) Choose the most professional procedure step.
A) The coupling is aligned with a laser tool.
B) We align maybe the coupling with laser.
C) The coupling aligns with a laser tool by us.
Answer: A

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب 4 جمل بالمبني للمجهول تصف إجراء تغيير فلتر الهواء في نظام هوائي (pneumatic)، مثل: The air supply is closed. The old filter is removed.
2) حوّل الجملتين إلى المبني للمجهول: We test the sensors every week. / The vendor updates the PLC software.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/passive-voice
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/passive-forms

items.titleArabic: المبني للمجهول مع الأفعال الناقصة: must be replaced وcan be repaired
items.titleEnglish: Modal passive: must be replaced, can be repaired
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
عندما نتخذ قرارات الإصلاح أو الاستبدال نجمع بين الفعل الناقص والمبني للمجهول: modal + be + past participle. هذا يسمح لنا بالتركيز على القطعة والقرار: The worn belt must be replaced. نستخدم must be للإلزام، وshould be للتوصية، وcan be للإمكانية، وcannot be لعدم الإمكانية، وwill be للخطة المستقبلية. الفعل be يبقى بصورته الأساسية دائمًا بعد الفعل الناقص، ولا يتغير مع المفرد أو الجمع: The bearing must be replaced / The bearings must be replaced.

الشكل (Form):
- must be + past participle → The cracked hose must be replaced.
- should be + past participle → The seals should be checked every month.
- can be + past participle → The old motor can be refurbished.
- cannot / can't be + past participle → This bearing cannot be repaired.
- will be + past participle → The spare part will be delivered on Monday.
- السؤال: Can this gearbox be repaired?

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) The gearbox can be repaired, but the worn gears must be replaced. — «يمكن إصلاح صندوق التروس، لكن يجب استبدال التروس المتآكلة.»
2) Critical spare parts should be kept in stock. — «ينبغي الاحتفاظ بقطع الغيار الحرجة في المخزون.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
يكتب المتعلمون «must replaced» أو «must be replace» أو «can repaired». تذكّر القاعدة الثلاثية: فعل ناقص + be + تصريف ثالث: must be replaced, can be repaired, should be checked.

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Choose the correct sentence.
A) The worn belt must replaced.
B) The worn belt must be replace.
C) The worn belt must be replaced.
Answer: C

2) Complete: This old motor can ___ refurbished.
A) be
B) is
C) been
Answer: A

3) Complete: The seals should be ___ every month.
A) check
B) checked
C) checking
Answer: B

4) Choose the correct form.
A) The pump cannot be repaired.
B) The pump cannot repaired.
C) The pump cannot be repairing.
Answer: A

5) Complete: The new sensor will ___ installed tomorrow.
A) be
B) is
C) being
Answer: A

6) Which sentence gives a recommendation?
A) The filters should be cleaned weekly.
B) The filters must be cleaned weekly.
C) The filters can't be cleaned weekly.
Answer: A

7) Which sentence shows that something is possible?
A) The housing must be reused.
B) The housing can be reused.
C) The housing will be reused.
Answer: B

8) Complete: Damaged PPE ___ be used. It is not safe.
A) must
B) can
C) must not
Answer: C

9) Choose the passive form of "We must replace the cable."
A) The cable must replace.
B) The cable must be replacing.
C) The cable must be replaced.
Answer: C

10) Complete: The order ___ be sent to the supplier today.
A) should to
B) should
C) is should
Answer: B

11) Complete: Critical spare parts ___ kept in stock.
A) should
B) should be
C) should being
Answer: B

12) Choose the correct question.
A) Can this gearbox be repaired?
B) Can be this gearbox repaired?
C) Can this gearbox repaired?
Answer: A

13) Complete: The warranty may ___ cancelled if you open the case.
A) be
B) being
C) to be
Answer: A

14) Choose the correct sentence about a delivery.
A) The replacement drive will delivered on Monday.
B) The replacement drive will be deliver on Monday.
C) The replacement drive will be delivered on Monday.
Answer: C

15) Complete: Worn brake pads ___ ignored.
A) must not
B) must not be
C) must be not
Answer: B

16) Complete: All fasteners should be ___ after transport.
A) tighten
B) tightened
C) tightening
Answer: B

17) Choose the active form of "The motor can be refurbished by the supplier."
A) The supplier can refurbished the motor.
B) The supplier can be refurbish the motor.
C) The supplier can refurbish the motor.
Answer: C

18) Complete: The part number ___ be checked twice before you order.
A) should
B) should be
C) is should
Answer: A

19) Choose the correct repair decision.
A) The shaft is bent, so it cannot repaired.
B) The shaft is bent, so it cannot be repair.
C) The shaft is bent, so it cannot be repaired.
Answer: C

20) Choose the best sentence for a parts request.
A) Two bearings must ordered today because the old ones worn.
B) Two bearings must be ordered today because the old ones are worn.
C) Two bearings must be order today because the old ones are wear.
Answer: B

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) قرّر بشأن ثلاث قطع: worn belt وcracked hose وdirty filter. اكتب لكل قطعة جملة واحدة بـ must be أو should be أو can be.
2) اكتب جملتين لمورّد (supplier) عن قطعة غيار باستخدام will be delivered وshould be packed.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/passive-forms
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/should

items.titleArabic: التعبير عن الغرض: to وin order to وso that في تقييم المخاطر
items.titleEnglish: Expressing purpose: to, in order to and so that
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
عند شرح إجراءات السلامة نحتاج إلى بيان الهدف من كل إجراء. أبسط طريقة هي to + الفعل الأساسي: Wear gloves to protect your hands. وفي الكتابة الرسمية نستخدم in order to بالمعنى نفسه: The area is fenced in order to keep visitors away. وعندما يأتي بعد الغرض فاعل وفعل نستخدم so that مع can/could أو will/would: Put a sign here so that everyone can see the hazard. وللغرض المنفي نستخدم in order not to أو so that ... don't/can't: Lock the panel so that nobody can open it. ولا نستخدم for + الفعل الأساسي للتعبير عن الغرض، بل for + اسم: for protection.

الشكل (Form):
- to + base verb → We use guards to prevent injuries.
- in order to + base verb (رسمي) → The line is stopped in order to inspect the rollers.
- in order not to + base verb → Lift with your legs in order not to hurt your back.
- so that + subject + can/will/could + verb → Label the valves so that operators can find them quickly.
- for + noun ✓ → We need gloves for protection. / for + verb ✗ → for protect

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) We installed a light curtain to stop the robot when someone enters the cell. — «ركّبنا ستارة ضوئية لإيقاف الروبوت عندما يدخل أحد إلى الخلية.»
2) Keep a record of near misses so that the team can find hidden hazards. — «احتفظ بسجل للحوادث الوشيكة حتى يتمكن الفريق من اكتشاف المخاطر الخفية.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
الخطأ الأشهر هو for + فعل: «We use gloves for protect our hands». الصحيح: «We use gloves to protect our hands» أو «for protection». ومن الأخطاء أيضًا استخدام so that بدون فاعل: «so that can see» والصحيح «so that everyone can see».

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Complete: Wear gloves ___ protect your hands.
A) to
B) for
C) for to
Answer: A

2) Choose the correct sentence.
A) We use a guard for prevent injuries.
B) We use a guard to prevent injuries.
C) We use a guard for to prevent injuries.
Answer: B

3) Complete: Put the sign here so that everyone ___ see it.
A) to
B) can
C) for
Answer: B

4) Complete: The line is stopped in order ___ inspect the rollers.
A) to
B) for
C) that
Answer: A

5) Which sentence expresses purpose correctly?
A) Label the cables so that technicians can trace them quickly.
B) Label the cables so that can trace them quickly.
C) Label the cables for trace them quickly.
Answer: A

6) Complete: We need safety glasses ___ protection.
A) to
B) so that
C) for
Answer: C

7) Complete: Lift with your legs ___ hurt your back.
A) in order to not
B) in order not to
C) for not
Answer: B

8) Complete: The area is fenced ___ keep visitors away.
A) in order for
B) so that to
C) in order to
Answer: C

9) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Switch off the power so that nobody to get a shock.
B) Switch off the power so that nobody gets a shock.
C) Switch off the power for nobody gets a shock.
Answer: B

10) Complete: We record near misses ___ learn from them.
A) for
B) so
C) to
Answer: C

11) Complete: Train new staff so that they ___ understand the risks.
A) will
B) to
C) for
Answer: A

12) Choose the correct formal sentence for a report.
A) Control measures were added in order reduce the risk score.
B) Control measures were added for reduce the risk score.
C) Control measures were added in order to reduce the risk score.
Answer: C

13) Complete: We put a mat near the press ___ workers do not slip.
A) to
B) in order to
C) so that
Answer: C

14) Complete: Use a CO2 extinguisher ___ fight electrical fires.
A) for
B) to
C) so that
Answer: B

15) Complete: The light curtain is installed ___ the robot stops when someone enters.
A) so that
B) in order to
C) to
Answer: A

16) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Keep the exits clear so that people can leave quickly.
B) Keep the exits clear so that people can to leave quickly.
C) Keep the exits clear for people leave quickly.
Answer: A

17) Complete: We rate likelihood and severity ___ calculate the risk score.
A) for
B) to
C) so that
Answer: B

18) Complete: Cover the sharp edges ___ cut yourself.
A) in order to
B) to
C) so that you don't
Answer: C

19) The reason for the guard is to protect hands. Choose the correct sentence.
A) The guard is there to protect hands.
B) The guard is there so that to protect hands.
C) The guard is there for protecting of hands.
Answer: A

20) Choose the best sentence for a risk assessment.
A) Add a second emergency stop for the operator can reach it from both sides.
B) Add a second emergency stop so that the operator can reach it from both sides.
C) Add a second emergency stop so that the operator reach it from both sides.
Answer: B

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب 3 إجراءات وقائية (control measures) لخطر في ورشتك، واشرح غرض كل إجراء باستخدام to وin order to وso that.
2) اكتب جملة واحدة تشرح لماذا نبلّغ عن الحوادث الوشيكة (near misses) باستخدام so that.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/in-order-to
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/so-that-or-in-order-that
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/conjunctions-causes-reasons-results-and-purpose

items.titleEnglish: Week review: the language of a safety briefing
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
إحاطة السلامة (safety briefing أو toolbox talk) حديث قصير قبل العمل يجمع أدوات هذا الأسبوع كلها: صيغة الأمر للتعليمات المباشرة (Wear your helmet)، وmust وhave to للإلزام، وmustn't للمنع، وdon't have to لعدم الضرورة، وظروف التكرار للجداول (The alarm is tested every Monday)، والمبني للمجهول لوصف الإجراءات (The area is evacuated)، والمجهول مع الأفعال الناقصة للقرارات (Damaged PPE must be replaced)، وto وso that لشرح الغرض. الإحاطة الجيدة قصيرة: تبدأ بالخطر الرئيسي، ثم الإجراءات، ثم ما يجب فعله في الطوارئ.

الشكل (Form):
- الخطر: The main hazard today is ...
- التعليمات: Wear ... / Do not ... / Never ...
- الإلزام والمنع: You must ... / You mustn't ... / You don't have to ...
- الإجراء: The power is isolated. / The tools must be checked.
- الغرض: ... to protect ... / ... so that everyone can ...
- الطوارئ: If the alarm sounds, stop work and go to the assembly point.

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) The main hazard today is moving parts, so the guards must be closed at all times. — «الخطر الرئيسي اليوم هو الأجزاء المتحركة، لذا يجب أن تبقى الواقيات مغلقة طوال الوقت.»
2) If the alarm sounds, leave your tools and go to the assembly point so that the supervisor can count everyone. — «إذا رنّ الإنذار، اترك أدواتك واذهب إلى نقطة التجمع حتى يتمكن المشرف من عدّ الجميع.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
في الإحاطات الشفهية يخلط المتعلمون بين mustn't وdon't have to، ويحذفون be في المبني للمجهول: «The area evacuated». راجع كل جملة: هل هي أمر، أم إلزام، أم منع، أم وصف إجراء؟

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Choose the correct instruction.
A) Wear your helmet in the loading area.
B) You wearing your helmet in the loading area.
C) Wears your helmet in the loading area.
Answer: A

2) Complete: You ___ use your phone while you drive the forklift.
A) don't have to
B) mustn't
C) have to
Answer: B

3) Complete: The fire alarm is tested ___ Monday.
A) every
B) all
C) each of
Answer: A

4) Choose the correct passive sentence.
A) The area evacuated when the alarm sounds.
B) The area is evacuated when the alarm sounds.
C) The area is evacuate when the alarm sounds.
Answer: B

5) Complete: Damaged gloves must ___ replaced.
A) being
B) to
C) be
Answer: C

6) Complete: Go to the assembly point ___ the supervisor can count everyone.
A) so that
B) to
C) for
Answer: A

7) Complete: Visitors ___ wear a helmet in the office. It is not necessary.
A) mustn't
B) must
C) don't have to
Answer: C

8) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Never to block the emergency exits.
B) Never block the emergency exits.
C) Not never block the emergency exits.
Answer: B

9) Complete: Fire extinguishers ___ checked once a month.
A) are
B) is
C) be
Answer: A

10) Choose the correct word order.
A) We start always the shift with a short briefing.
B) Always we starts the shift with a short briefing.
C) We always start the shift with a short briefing.
Answer: C

11) Complete: Use the stairs ___ leave the building in an emergency.
A) to
B) for
C) so that
Answer: A

12) Complete: Last month we ___ evacuate the workshop because of smoke.
A) must
B) had to
C) have to
Answer: B

13) Which sentence means "it is forbidden"?
A) You don't have to open the panel.
B) You can open the panel.
C) You mustn't open the panel.
Answer: C

14) Complete: The machine guard ___ removed during operation.
A) must not
B) must not be
C) is not be
Answer: B

15) Choose the correct question.
A) How often is the first aid kit checked?
B) How often the first aid kit is checked?
C) How often does the first aid kit checked?
Answer: A

16) Complete: Report every near miss ___ order to prevent accidents.
A) for
B) so
C) in
Answer: C

17) Choose the best opening for a safety briefing.
A) Good morning. Today's main hazard is the hot surface of the oven.
B) Good morning. Today main hazard are hot surface of oven.
C) Good morning. Today's main hazard being the hot surface of the oven.
Answer: A

18) Complete: Spare fuses ___ kept in the red box.
A) is
B) are
C) be
Answer: B

19) Choose the correct sentence.
A) If the alarm sounds, stopping work and leave the building.
B) If the alarm will sound, stop work and leaves the building.
C) If the alarm sounds, stop work and leave the building.
Answer: C

20) Choose the best closing sentence for a briefing.
A) Any questions? If not, checking your PPE and starting work safely.
B) Any questions? If not, check your PPE and start work safely.
C) Any question? If no, you checks your PPE and start work safely.
Answer: B

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب نص إحاطة سلامة قصيرة (5–6 جمل) قبل صيانة ذراع روبوت: اذكر الخطر الرئيسي، وتعليمتين بصيغة الأمر، وقاعدة بـ must وأخرى بـ mustn't، وإجراء الطوارئ.
2) اكتب جملتين بالمبني للمجهول عن الفحوصات الدورية في ورشتك، مثل: The alarm is tested every Monday.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/commands-and-instructions
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/must
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/passive-uses
